description: US-39 „Karten drucken" — a reminder for cards still to be printed. THE SOFTWARE PRINTS NO CARDS; DF sometimes hand out a TEMPORARY card and print the real one later, and today only memory keeps track. EVERY NEWLY ISSUED CARD IS NOW 'PRINTED' (a stored printedAt date) OR 'NOT YET PRINTED' (null). ISSUED BY HAND — registration, loss reissue (record + card view), stale-counts reissue on /karten-neuausstellung — a checkbox „Karte ist bereits gedruckt", UNTICKED BY DEFAULT (opt-in). ISSUED AUTOMATICALLY — a customer-number change, incl. group change — ALWAYS NOT YET PRINTED, no checkbox. A NEW LIST /karten-drucken shows every ACTIVE OR BLOCKED household (ARCHIVED leave it) whose CURRENT card is not yet printed — at most one row per household, a replaced card leaves the list — oldest issue first; each row is ticked off ONE AT A TIME (no batch), and RIGHT AFTER a tick the list offers „Rückgängig" (no reason asked; no undo anywhere else or later). It is a real US-38 TO-DO: a row in „Zu erledigen" on Start only while > 0, and a tile under Übersichten (area Kunden) always, 0 included, both from ONE count. /karten-drucken belongs to the Übersichten tab. The card view shows „Gedruckt am …" per card. Ticking and undoing write AUDIT entries (customer.card.printed / customer.card.printUndone; what and when, never who). ALL CARDS EXISTING AT GO-LIVE COUNT AS PRINTED (seeds write printedAt = issuedAt). NOTHING CHANGES AT THE COUNTER — a not-yet-printed card is valid exactly as before. SCHEMA CHANGE: Card.printedAt DateTime?, migrations regenerated (pre-release; re-add BOTH hand-written partial indexes). One new port method (CardRepository.setPrintedAt), two domain functions (markPrinted/unmarkPrinted), three typed errors (CardAlreadyPrinted, CardNotPrinted, CardSuperseded), ADR-022. Requirement: local_only/cards-to-print/requirement.md (decisions D1–D12). Full PRD: tasks/prd-us-39-cards-to-print.md.
